maddeler.e:
اختلقوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَقُوا (iḵtalaqū) /ix.ta.la.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# اُخْتُلِقُوا (uḵtuliqū) /ux.tu.li.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# اِخْتَلِقُوا (iḵtaliqū) /ix.ta.li.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
